hook: Set slow countdowns ticking, then watch Dripstone pile up until your sleepy olms wake huge.
loop: Play units with Vigils, and speed their countdowns with Knockers and bells.
Each Vigil that ends adds Dripstone, which never goes down.
Olmlings, the Eldest and Ribica cash Dripstone into huge boards and goldens.

growth.line: Little before turn 4; then Dripstone climbs 3–6 a turn and payoffs grow faster each turn.

feel.early: Weak and slow; only Kurent and Olmling can fight.
feel.mid: Clocks interlock; plan which Vigil ends last for Netopir.
feel.late: Dripstone-fed Olmlings and Ribica goldens take over the board.

stars.why: Tiny seed that grows with every ending into a late carry.
Repeats whoever ended last, so the order of clocks matters.
Every short clock speeds her toward a golden copy.

card_short.u01: Vigil 3: grows permanently for each Dripstone.
card_short.u02: When played: your Vigils count down by 1.
card_short.u04: When a Vigil ends, buff a random unit next to it.
card_short.u05: When played: gives a unit without a Vigil a growing Vigil.
card_short.u07: Vigil 2: your other Vigils count down by 1.
card_short.u08: Vigil 2: whole board gains Health or Attack, flipping each time.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: gains Attack for each Dripstone.
card_short.u10: When a Vigil ends, that unit grows permanently.
card_short.u11: When played: copies a Vigil onto a unit without one.
card_short.u12: End of Turn: repeats the last Vigil effect that ended.
card_short.u13: Swoop. Gain 3 gold on turns no Vigil ends.
card_short.u14: Your Vigils also count down at End of Turn.
card_short.u15: Other Vigils are 1 longer; their stats and gold double.
card_short.u16: Start of Combat: Vigil units grow by Dripstone.
card_short.u17: Deep Vigil 8: your other units grow by Dripstone.
card_short.u18: Deep Vigil 12: get a golden copy of a unit.
card_short.u19: Counts as every tribe; grows by Dripstone and every ending.

builds.name: The long count
builds.line: Many short Vigils pile up Dripstone; Olmlings, Eldest and Dragon cash in.

builds.name: The clutch
builds.line: Feed Mother Ribica endings for golden copies of your best unit.

builds.name: The quiet house
builds.line: Vigils end together on one loud turn; Robber-Knight pays for quiet ones.

liked: Brother Netopir, repeating whoever ended last, makes the order of your clocks a puzzle.
Short clocks feeding Deep Vigils and Ribica's golden clutch tie every tier together.
worries: Mother Ribica, repeated by Netopir, may give goldens every turn; Discover rule unwritten.
Pale Olmling, Sitter, Eldest may run away late; Dragon needs every-tribe checks.
changed: Each Vigil ends at most once a turn, stopping endless Knocker goldens.
Pale Olmling went from 1/2 to 2/2 for early fights.
Netopir, Parkelj, Sitter and lake now spell out exactly what and when.
verdict: Rated 7.0 fun and 6.7 distinct, it ranked first of its seed's three; for players who enjoy timing puzzles and slow payoffs.
